title: Pre-wash!!!  Colors bleed like crazy!!!
text: Pre-wash!!!  Colors bleed like crazy!!!. I could not get a photo to upload to this page........I washed these towels in warm water with Color Catchers, which came out bright blue-green.  I washed a second time using Retayne (Amazon sells this) in the water.  Color Catchers came out clear.  It is super important to prewash ALL kitchen towels before use.  You do not want a nasty surprise.  Many countries do not prewash, so you have to be very careful.  I would not give them as a gift for this reason.
